← Campaigns

Senior Living Owners (SL-Awareness): LinkedIn Ads

Eighteen short awareness ads for senior living owners who don't know Boldt, each built on one point from Heidi's strategy deck, in light gray, navy and black, each with a hand-drawn illustration. LI-01 to LI-06 are the core set; LI-07 to LI-16 are new variations to test. Ready for manager review.

Manager review 0 approved0 need changes0 not reviewed0 removed Background

Editing is on for every ad. Click any text on an ad, its intro text or its LinkedIn headline to change it. Changes save in this browser as you type. Click Done editing to enlarge ads again.

How this file is organized

Each ad makes one specific point from Heidi's Off-Market Senior Living Strategy deck: retiring from operations, who takes care of residents, the third option, cashing out while keeping a share, one buyer with no auction, a buyer that closes, and what the community is worth. The variations add staffing and compliance, your team, not ready to sell, after-tax results, family succession, capital tied up, culture, a long sale, a second payout and a direct callout to owners of 1 to 15 communities. LI-04B tests the word "Monetize" against LI-04, and LI-R1 is for retargeting only.

  1. Type your name in the review bar.
  2. Each ad appears three times: light gray, navy and black. Remove the sets you don't want, or keep two to test them against each other.
  3. Click Approve or Needs changes under each ad, and add notes if needed.
  4. To change wording, click Edit text under an ad, then click its headline, support line, intro text or LinkedIn headline. Edit all text in the review bar turns editing on for every ad.
  5. Click Remove ad twice to delete an ad from the file.
  6. Everything saves automatically for everyone who opens this page in the dashboard. Download review summary gives a spreadsheet of every decision.

The 1200x628 versions, Google display ads, video, guide and landing page are on the Campaigns tab.

Hover over any ad to see it larger. Click to keep it open, and press Esc to close.
